reason_for_wait_queue: Completion counts are consumed, and complete_all reset requires draining waiters. A readiness predicate avoids resetting a completion concurrently with a waiter.

model_tracks: child NGD base assigned after platform_device_add
parent_readiness_contract.child_binding_during_cancellation: A synthetic binding-completion hook runs the exact child probe during cancellation after parent closure; device-core and device-lock scheduling is not executed.
parent_readiness_contract.limits: Only startup notification/work admission is qualified. Master work, external PM/TX/DMA callbacks, device-core locks and complete removal are not modeled.
